# Peak Property Gardening Services

Peak Property Gardening Services offers practical garden and property care in Chesterfield and surrounding areas.

## Services
- Garden care, including weeding, tidying and edging
- Hedge trimming
- Jet washing for patios, paths and outdoor hard surfaces
- Garden rubbish and clutter removal
- Small demolition work
- Outdoor painting, including fences and exterior details

## Service area
Chesterfield and surrounding areas. Customers should share their postcode to confirm availability.

## Contact
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/peakpgs/

## Quote information
For an accurate discussion, include your name, postcode, service needed, a short description and clear photographs of the area.
